**Finding resubmitted: deviation (§ 14.2, p0054).**

Repair made in this pass — the only outstanding item was the citation nit:

- Comment now cites **Sections 13.1–13.3**, matching the rationale (13.1 Affiliate/contractor coverage, 13.2 perpetual paid-up grant, 13.3 transfer and revocation limits).
- Rationale now also explains the changed-character ratio: the paragraph is a single short sentence in which revocability, transferability, term and licensee scope are all rule-targeted elements, so density rather than scope creep drives the figure.

The redline ops are unchanged and revalidated (ok:true), leaving Vendor's ownership sentence and the "use a Deliverable" scope intact. Fallback position (Affiliates on written notice, transfer limited to an M&A successor) remains on the table in the comment.
